review.brief_reason: The proposed simplification factors 0.9 out of the Abs() in the original: (0.9*theta+0.9) becomes 0.9*(theta+1), and then 0.9 is moved outside Abs as sqrt(0.9*Abs(...)). However, sqrt(0.9*Abs(X)) = sqrt(0.9)*sqrt(Abs(X)), not 0.853814968245462*sqrt(0.9*Abs(X)). The constant 0.853814968245462 was not adjusted to absorb sqrt(0.9), so the expressions are not equivalent. Numerical check: with p_d=0, theta=0, epsilon=0, Ef=0, original inner sqrt argument = 0.853814968245462*sqrt(Abs((-0.2)*(0.9)*(80*cos(0.9)+0.07-0.9/((-0.006)*(0.09)))))-0.001111... while proposed has sqrt(0.9*Abs(...)) which changes the value by a factor of sqrt(0.9) inside. These are not equal.
review.counterexample: p_d=0, theta=0, epsilon=0, Ef=0: original computes 0.853814968245462*sqrt(Abs((-0.2)*(0.9)*(80*cos(0.9)+0.07-0.9/((-0.006)*(0.09)))))-0.001111...; proposed computes 0.853814968245462*sqrt(0.9*Abs((-0.2)*(1)*(80*cos(0.9)+0.07-0.9/((-0.006)*(0.09)))))-0.001111...; the proposed multiplies the Abs argument by 0.9 without compensating the outer constant, yielding a different value (off by factor sqrt(0.9)).
